test_calibrate_threshold: test calibrate_threshold to compute a corrected quantile threshold for conformal prediction given validation conformity scores and labels
test_predict_threshold: test predict_threshold to generate confidence sets from conformity scores and a calibrated threshold
test_compute_ranks: test compute_ranks to rank test conformity scores against validation conformity scores
test_compute_p_values: test compute_p_values to compute p-values for test examples using validation conformity scores and labels
test_conformal_quantile: test conformal_quantile to compute a corrected quantile for conformal inference given scores and confidence level
